Replaced by a newer release. It still unlocks and lets you move to the newer release, nothing more.

Changes

  • Connections can ask you for information under rules you set, with rate limits per connection rule (VAULT-MESSAGING 0.23.0).
  • Fixes to merging tags and resuming asks (VAULT-MESSAGING 0.23.1).
  • Built from vettid-vault commit c22a750 (tag release/staging/7) and independently rebuilt on 2026-10-09 with a matching PCR0.

Security

No security fix
